blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-16"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { advance = "environment" }

diagnostics.message: [sandbox] clock needs enforce: "preload" (a library in the sandbox; fidelity, not protection), "vm" (a guest with its own clock), or "world" (the task's own services hold the time)
